thread:
Miles: Heads up — proposing a standardized lead queue + escalation map for SI-sourced / influenced deals across cloud marketplaces and hardware partners. Sketch below; need ops + legal + field to weigh in.

Asha: Can you drop the SFDC filter and queue ownership? we need MQL -> SAL mapping and rules for multi-partner leads.

Miles: Sure, quick draft filter and queue rules:
```
Filter: Lead.Type = "SI" AND Lead.Status != "Closed" AND (Lead.Region IN ("NA", "EMEA", "APAC"))
Queue assignment:
  - NA: partnerships-na-queue (owns initial outreach)
  - EMEA: partnerships-emea-queue (requires SE approval for EMEA accounts)
  - APAC: partnerships-apac-queue (APAC PM will triage)
Escalation: 48h first-touch SLA, 72h required update or escalate to Partnerships Lead
Claiming rule: first-touch owner unless Account.Type = "Named" (see account mapping table)
Tags: SI_Partner = <partner_name>, Partner_Channel = {marketplace|hardware|system-integrator}
```

Noah: This looks good. couple notes: 1) EMEA deals must trigger EU data/privacy review step before partner data is shared. 2) For hardware partners we need a tech-validation checkbox (HW_Integration = true) so infra can plan.

Priya: Legal: +1 on privacy review. We'll add a required checkbox "Partner Data Share OK" and a short NDA pointer for co-sell engagements. I'll draft a one-paragraph marketplace listing consent clause.

Tom: Field ops: add embargo window for joint announcements — prefer 14 days notice before any public co-branded announcement. Also please include funnel tag format: `SI:partner=<partner_name>` so we can filter reports.

Ria: GTM: add `marketplace_listing` boolean and `marketplace_launch_date` fields to intake so marketing can autoschedule ASSETS and listing copy. Also signal if partner requires joint PR.

Asha: Ops question — multiple partners on same account: who gets SFDC credit? propose: first-touch claim for lead routing + partner-of-record logic at Opportunity conversion (i.e., at SQL -> Opportunity, partner owner is locked and gets partner credit). Any objections?

Noah: Fine with that but note: for named accounts there should be a manual account-owner override in the account mapping table. I'll take ownership of building that table (CSV -> GSheet -> sync to SFDC).

Miles: Nice. Action items:
- Noah: draft account mapping CSV + provisioning instructions (owner)
- Asha: implement SFDC queues, validation rules, and claim/escalation rules in sandbox
- Priya: prepare NDA/marketplace consent snippets for legal template
- Ria: add marketplace fields to GTM intake form and notify marketing ops
- Tom: publish embargo guidance to partner-runbook

Let's sync Fri 10am to finalize — please react :thumbsup: if you can make it or reply w/ blockers.

salesforce-bot: SFDC sandbox queue `partnerships-na-queue` created (sandbox) — https://redwood.salesforce.com/00GXXXXXXXXXXXX :white_check_mark:
